array.string: [ -e /tmp/dayframe-installing ] && exit 0; if ! /usr/bin/pgrep -f '^/Applications/Jarvis.app/Contents/MacOS/Jarvis' >/dev/null && [ -d /Applications/Jarvis.app ]; then echo "$(date '+%F %T') reopening Jarvis"; /usr/bin/open -g -a /Applications/Jarvis.app; fi; if ! /usr/bin/pgrep -f 'Ollama.app/Contents/Resources/ollama serve' >/dev/null && [ -d /Applications/Ollama.app ]; then echo "$(date '+%F %T') reopening Ollama"; /usr/bin/open -g -a /Applications/Ollama.app; fi; exit 0
